title: FFNN-GA-Assisted Process Modeling and Optimization of Banana Fiber Pretreatment for Retrieval of Cellulose fiber and Other Value-Added Byproducts
summary: The AI-guided search identified a candidate pretreatment condition that balanced lignin recovery, sugar loss, and cellulose preservation. The paper reports a confirmatory experiment at the predicted condition as well as train/validation/test model checks. This is a small study with data available from the authors on request; the preprint is not peer reviewed.
ai_technology: A feed-forward neural network modeled measured process responses; a genetic algorithm searched the learned response surface for an optimum.
organization: Not stated in the reviewed material
